create_TupleActionSpace_env: create a TupleActionSpace gym environment with tuple of discrete action spaces
reset_TupleActionSpace: reset the TupleActionSpace environment and return the initial observation
step_TupleActionSpace: step the TupleActionSpace environment with a tuple action and get observation and reward
review_TupleActionSpace_reward: review the TupleActionSpace reward calculation which sums action[1] minus action[0]
test_TupleActionSpace_step: test the TupleActionSpace step method with a valid tuple action of two arrays
